sites.prompt:
# Premium Animated Beauty Salon Website – ZEE Beauty Saloon, Mughalpura, Lahore
Act as a world-class UI/UX designer, creative director, and senior full-stack web developer. Design and develop a stunning, premium, elegant, fully responsive website for **ZEE Beauty Saloon**, located in Mughalpura, Lahore, Pakistan.
The website should look like a high-end international beauty salon brand, with sophisticated animations, beautiful visuals, luxurious typography, smooth transitions, and an exceptional user experience.
## 1. Business Information
Use the following verified business information:
- Business Name: ZEE Beauty Saloon
- Business Category: Beauty Salon
- Address: Shop #2, Mian Mir Market, Main Bazar, near Moughal Shadi Hall, Sahowari Mughalpura, Lahore, Pakistan.
- Phone: +92 323 4325141
- Listed Business Hours: Daily, 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.
- Location: Mughalpura, Lahore.
- Official Website: No verified independent website currently identified.
Important: Do not invent business services, prices, awards, staff names, customer testimonials, social media profiles, or promotional offers. Services and pricing must be editable placeholders until confirmed by the business owner.
## 2. Design Direction and Visual Identity
Create a luxurious feminine beauty aesthetic.
Color palette:
- Soft Blush Pink: #F7DDE5
- Champagne Gold: #D4AF72
- Warm Ivory: #FFF9F4
- Elegant Rose: #C77D91
- Deep Charcoal: #292329
- Pure White: #FFFFFF
Typography:
- Use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for elegant headings.
- Use Poppins or Inter for clean body text.
Design requirements:
- Minimal yet luxurious layout.
- Beautiful whitespace and premium spacing.
- Elegant rounded corners.
- Soft shadows and subtle glass effects.
- High-quality salon and beauty photography.
- Consistent visual identity throughout the website.
Avoid a generic salon template. Make the website feel custom-designed specifically for ZEE Beauty Saloon.
## 3. Hero Section – First Impression
Create an impressive full-screen hero section.
Main heading:
"Your Beauty, Your Confidence, Our Passion."
Supporting text:
"Discover a beautiful experience where elegance meets care. Welcome to ZEE Beauty Saloon, your beauty destination in Mughalpura, Lahore."
Buttons:
- Explore Our Services
- Book Your Appointment
Visual direction:
- Large premium beauty photography.
- Elegant image composition.
- Animated heading entrance.
- Soft floating decorative elements.
- Subtle golden glow effects.
- Smooth parallax scrolling.
- Beautiful animated background transitions.
Add a premium ZEE Beauty Saloon logo treatment in the navigation.
## 4. About Us Section
Heading: "Welcome to ZEE Beauty Saloon"
Create an elegant introduction section explaining the salon's beauty-focused identity.
Suggested copy:
"At ZEE Beauty Saloon, beauty is all about feeling confident, comfortable, and special. We aim to create a welcoming beauty experience where every client feels valued."
Include:
- Beautiful salon-themed imagery.
- Elegant text animations.
- Image reveal effects.
- A premium editorial-style layout.
Do not claim years of experience, certifications, or professional achievements without confirmation.
## 5. Our Services Section
Create an attractive service showcase with beautiful image cards.
Prepare editable service cards for the following categories, subject to owner confirmation:
1. Bridal Makeup
2. Party Makeup
3. Hair Styling
4. Haircuts
5. Hair Treatments
6. Facial Treatments
7. Skincare
8. Waxing
9. Threading
10. Manicure & Pedicure
Each service card should include:
- High-quality relevant image.
- Service title.
- Short description.
- Learn More button.
- Book Appointment button.
Keep prices hidden until the salon provides an official price list.
## 6. Beauty Gallery
Create a premium image gallery showcasing beauty-related visuals.
Gallery categories:
- Makeup Inspiration
- Bridal Looks
- Hair Styling
- Beauty Treatments
- Salon Interior
Features:
- Responsive masonry grid.
- Smooth hover zoom.
- Image lightbox.
- Elegant fade-in animations.
- Category filtering.
Use licensed, high-quality images or real salon photographs supplied by the owner. Never present stock photography as actual customer work.
## 7. Why Choose Us Section
Create a beautiful section highlighting the salon's intended customer experience.
Suggested highlights:
- Welcoming Atmosphere
- Personalized Beauty Experience
- Attention to Detail
- Beauty and Self-Care
- Convenient Mughalpura Location
Avoid unsupported claims about professional qualifications, hygiene certifications, or product brands.
## 8. Appointment Booking Section
Create a premium appointment booking experience.
Include these fields:
- Customer Name
- Phone Number
- Desired Service
- Preferred Date
- Preferred Time
- Additional Message
Add a prominent "Book Your Appointment" button.
Functionality:
- Validate all required fields.
- Provide a WhatsApp booking option.
- Send booking details to WhatsApp using the salon's verified number: +92 323 4325141.
- Use the WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/923234325141
- Display a clear confirmation message.
- Do not pretend an appointment is confirmed until the salon accepts it.

Heading: "Visit ZEE Beauty Saloon"
Display:
- ZEE Beauty Saloon
- Shop #2, Mian Mir Market, Main Bazar, near Moughal Shadi Hall, Sahowari Mughalpura, Lahore.
- Phone: +92 323 4325141
- Listed Hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM daily (confirm with owner).
Add:
- Interactive Google Maps embed or directions link.
- Click-to-call functionality.
- WhatsApp contact button.
- Contact form.
- Attractive location section.
## 10. Premium Animations and Interactions
Make animations an important part of the experience.
Implement:
- Smooth scrolling.
- GSAP or Framer Motion animations.
- Scroll-triggered reveal animations.
- Staggered text animations.
- Image masking and reveal effects.
- Smooth hover transitions.
- Floating decorative elements.
- Animated navigation menu.
- Elegant page transitions.
- Interactive service cards.
- Subtle parallax effects.
- Animated booking button.
- Smooth gallery interactions.
Keep animations elegant and lightweight. Avoid excessive movement or distracting effects.
Respect reduced-motion accessibility preferences.
## 11. Navigation Bar
Create a premium sticky navigation bar.
Menu:
- Home
- About
- Services
- Gallery
- Contact
Add a highlighted "Book Now" button.
On mobile, use an elegant animated hamburger menu.
## 12. Footer
Create a beautiful footer featuring:
- ZEE Beauty Saloon logo.
- Short brand introduction.
- Quick navigation links.
- Contact information.
- Location.
- Opening hours.
- WhatsApp contact button.
- Copyright information.
Do not add unverified social media links.
## 13. Technical Requirements
Build the website using:
- React.js or Next.js.
- Tailwind CSS.
- Framer Motion or GSAP.
- Lucide icons.
- Reusable and clean components.
Requirements:
- Fully responsive design.
- Mobile-first development.
- Optimized images.
- Fast loading performance.
- SEO-friendly structure.
- Semantic HTML.
- Accessible navigation.
- Proper form validation.
- Working WhatsApp integration.
- Clean and maintainable code.
SEO keywords:
- ZEE Beauty Saloon Mughalpura
- Beauty Salon in Mughalpura Lahore
- Beauty Parlour in Lahore
- Beauty Salon Near Mian Mir Market
- Makeup Salon Mughalpura
Add appropriate local business structured data using verified business information only.
## 14. Final Creative Direction
The final result must feel like a premium international beauty brand website.
Make the homepage visually impressive, with a luxurious hero, elegant typography, beautiful photography, sophisticated animations, interactive service cards, and an attractive appointment booking experience.
Prioritize:
1. Stunning visual appearance.
2. Premium user experience.
3. Smooth and meaningful animations.
4. Mobile responsiveness.
5. Easy appointment booking.
6. Fast loading and SEO.
The website should be production-quality, fully functional, visually consistent, and ready for deployment.
**Final Goal:** Transform ZEE Beauty Saloon's online presence into a beautiful, memorable, professional digital brand that attracts potential customers in Mughalpura and surrounding areas of Lahore.

sites.prompt:
## PROJECT OVERVIEW
Design and develop a modern, premium, fully responsive food ordering website for **Rocksteady Campus**, a proudly South African township takeaway located in the heart of Rockville, Soweto.
Rocksteady Campus serves the community with generous portions of freshly prepared Kotas, Dagwoods, Burgers, Rolls, Sandwiches and more, using quality ingredients at affordable prices.
The website must deliver an online food ordering experience inspired by Uber Eats and Mr D Food, combining premium aesthetics, intuitive navigation, beautiful food photography and a seamless ordering process.
The overall experience must feel professional, exciting, welcoming and authentically South African.
## 1. BRAND IDENTITY & COLOUR PALETTE
Use the uploaded Rocksteady Campus logo as the primary brand identity.
Extract and apply the following brand colours consistently:
- Primary Red: #F1001F
- Black: #000000
- White: #FFFFFF Design direction:
- Premium, contemporary food delivery aesthetic.
- Bold typography with modern, readable fonts.
- Clean layouts, generous spacing and beautiful food photography.
- Red call-to-action buttons against white and black backgrounds.
- Stylish cards with subtle shadows and rounded corners.
- Professional animations and smooth transitions.
- Use the official logo throughout the website, including the navigation bar, footer and login portal. Do not redesign or distort the original logo.
## 2. WEBSITE STRUCTURE
Create the following pages:
### HOME PAGE
- Premium hero section featuring delicious, high-quality food photography(Use the attached images).
- Main headline: "BIG FLAVOUR. GENEROUS PORTIONS. REAL TOWNSHIP TASTE."
- Supporting text introducing Rocksteady Campus.
- Prominent "ORDER NOW" and "EXPLORE OUR MENU" buttons.
- Featured menu categories.
- Best-selling and customer favourite meals.
- Special promotions and daily deals.
- Why customers choose Rocksteady Campus.
- Customer testimonials and ratings.
- Location, opening hours and contact information.
- Attractive footer with social media links.
### ABOUT US PAGE
Tell the story of Rocksteady Campus and its proudly South African township identity.
Include:
- Our Story.
- Our Passion for Good Food.
- Our Commitment to Quality.
- Freshly Prepared Meals.
- Generous Portions at Affordable Prices.
- Our Community in Rockville, Soweto. Use lifestyle, restaurant and food photographs. All wording and images must be editable through the admin dashboard.
### MENU PAGE
Create a visually attractive digital menu similar to Uber Eats.
Organise menu items into categories:
- Kotas(We have 10 Kotas)
- Dagwoods (We have 4 Dagwoods)
- Burgers (We have 3 Burgers)
- Rolls (We have 5 Rolls)
- Sandwiches (We have 3 Sandwiches)
- Chips & Sides (We have 25 Extras)
- Beverages
- Specials & Combos Each menu item must have:
- Food photograph.
- Meal name.
- Detailed description.
- Price in South African Rand (ZAR).
- Available add-ons and extras.
- Customisation options.
- Availability status.
- ADD TO CART button. Include category filters, search functionality and featured meals. Allow administrators to add, edit, delete and reorder categories and menu items, change prices, replace photographs and update descriptions.
### ONLINE ORDER PAGE
Develop a fully functional online ordering system with an experience comparable to Uber Eats and Mr D Food.
Features:
- Browse menu and add meals to cart.
- Increase or decrease quantities.
- Customise meals and add extras.
- Display item totals and order subtotal.
- Calculate delivery fees based on administrator-configured settings.
- Select collection or delivery.
- Capture customer name, mobile number and delivery address.
- Allow customers to add special instructions.
- Display a complete order summary.
- Support configurable online payment integration.
- Provide Cash on Collection or other enabled payment options.
- Generate order confirmation and unique order numbers.
- Allow customers to view order progress. Provide an order management dashboard where staff can accept, reject, prepare and complete orders. Do not display payment methods as functional until properly integrated and configured.
### GALLERY PAGE
Create a premium visual gallery showcasing:
- Delicious Kotas and Dagwoods.
- Burgers and sandwiches.
- Freshly prepared meals.
- Restaurant and takeaway experience.
- Food preparation.
- Brand and lifestyle photography. Use a responsive image grid with attractive hover effects and lightbox viewing. Administrators must be able to upload, replace, delete and rearrange images without editing website code.
### REVIEWS PAGE
Create a customer reviews section with:
- Overall star rating.
- Customer testimonials.
- Customer names and review dates.
- Five-star rating display.
- Customer review submission form.
- Review moderation dashboard. Allow administrators to approve, hide or remove reviews before publication.
### LOGIN PORTAL
Create a secure login system with two separate access levels:
CUSTOMER PORTAL:
- Customer registration and login.
- Password recovery.
- Customer profile management.
- Saved delivery addresses.
- Previous orders and order history.
- Order tracking. ADMINISTRATOR PORTAL:
- Secure administrator login.
- Dashboard overview.
- Manage website content and photographs.
- Manage menu categories, meals and prices.
- Manage incoming orders.
- Manage customers and reviews.
- Manage promotions and special offers.
- Update business details and opening hours.
- View basic sales and order reports. Protect administrator access with role-based permissions and secure authentication.
### CONTACT PAGE WITH GEOLOCATION
Display Rocksteady Campus business information prominently.
Business Name: Rocksteady Campus
Address: 1563 Makapane Street, Rockville, Soweto, 1818, South Africa.
Telephone: 063 104 4361
Opening Hours:
Monday – Saturday: 11:00 – 20:00
Sunday: Closed (unless updated by administrator).
Include:
- Interactive Google Maps location showing the restaurant.
- Get Directions button.
- Click-to-call telephone link.
- WhatsApp contact button.
- Contact enquiry form.
- Social media links.
- Customer location permission for address assistance during delivery checkout. Ensure the map points to the correct business address.
## 3. WEBSITE DESIGN & USER EXPERIENCE
The website must be:
- Fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile.
- Mobile-first and optimised for fast food ordering.
- SEO-friendly.
- Fast loading with compressed, optimised images.
- Easy to navigate.
- Accessible and readable.
- Designed with clear calls to action. Include a sticky navigation menu, shopping cart icon with item count, prominent Order Now buttons and a mobile-friendly navigation menu. Use subtle animations without compromising speed. The ordering experience should be simple, with as few unnecessary steps as possible.
## 4. EDITABLE WEBSITE & CONTENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
THIS IS A CRITICAL REQUIREMENT.
Build a complete, user-friendly Content Management System (CMS) with an administrator dashboard.
I must be able to manage the entire website without programming knowledge.
Every page must have editable content, including:
- All headings and paragraphs.
- All descriptions and promotional messages.
- All contact details and business information.
- All menu categories and food descriptions.
- All menu prices and meal photographs.
- All homepage banners and backgrounds.
- All gallery images.
- All About Us content.
- All customer reviews and testimonials.
- Opening hours and location details.
- Website footer and social media links. Provide an image manager that allows me to upload new photographs, replace existing photographs, delete images and choose where photographs appear. Do not hardcode website content or images in a way that prevents editing through the CMS. Use reusable website components and connect all editable content to a manageable database or CMS.
## 5. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Build a professional, production-ready website.
- Use a scalable and secure website architecture.
- Implement a functional shopping cart and ordering system.
- Connect the website to a database for menu items, customers and orders.
- Include secure authentication.
- Include order notifications and configurable payment integration.
- Optimise for Google search.
- Include social media sharing and WhatsApp integration.
- Ensure website content is easy to maintain.
- Provide backup and security considerations. Use South African Rand (ZAR) throughout the ordering system.
## 6. FINAL DESIGN EXPECTATION
The finished website must look and feel like a premium food delivery brand, comparable in quality and usability to Uber Eats and Mr D Food, but with a distinctive Rocksteady Campus identity.
Use professional food photography, bold red branding, elegant layouts and an exciting visual presentation.
The website must position Rocksteady Campus as one of Soweto's exciting township takeaway destinations.
**BRAND MESSAGE:**
"ROCKSTEADY CAMPUS – BIG FLAVOUR. GENEROUS PORTIONS. REAL TOWNSHIP TASTE."
Build all eight pages, the customer login experience, administrator portal, editable CMS and online ordering functionality as one integrated website.
The final result must be visually impressive, easy to use, fully editable and ready for future business growth.
Make sure the website is editable i need to be able to change a pictures seamlessly, and change text throughout the website seamlessly. The Hero Banner must be 5 sliding images that are attached and use the logo at the top left header and footer.
I want you to analyze the attached image, the Picture 3(file name Homepage) is how i want the website to look and feel, and picture 2 (File Name Digital Menu) is how i want the menu page to look like, and picture 3 (File Name Admin Dashboard) is how i want the admin portal/dashboard to look and and feel like.

# Build LifeOS – A Premium Personal Productivity Platform
Create a polished, modern, fully responsive personal productivity web application called **LifeOS**.
The application should feel like a real premium SaaS product, combining the simplicity of Notion, the task management experience of Todoist, and the analytics of a productivity tracker.
IMPORTANT: This is a frontend-only static website. Use HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript. Do not require a backend, database, authentication service, or paid API.
## 1. Design System
Create a minimal, clean, professional interface.
Visual direction:
- Off-white background (#F8F9FB).
- White content cards.
- Dark charcoal text.
- Soft indigo/blue primary accent.
- Subtle gray borders.
- Rounded corners (12–16px).
- Soft shadows.
- Modern typography using Inter or Geist.
- Consistent spacing and alignment.
Avoid:
- Excessive gradients.
- Neon colors.
- Overly large rounded elements.
- Cluttered dashboards.
- Unnecessary animations.
The final design should look like a professionally designed commercial SaaS application.
## 2. Application Layout
Create a desktop-first dashboard with:
**Sidebar navigation:**
- LifeOS logo.
- Overview.
- My Tasks.
- Habits.
- Calendar.
- Focus Mode.
- Notes.
- Analytics.
- Settings.
Include active navigation highlighting and a collapsible sidebar.
**Top navigation:**
- Page title.
- Search bar.
- Notification icon.
- Current date.
- User profile avatar.
- Theme toggle.
On mobile, convert the sidebar into a responsive navigation menu.
## 3. Dashboard Overview
Create an informative dashboard with:
- Personalized greeting.
- Current date.
- Daily productivity summary.
- Total tasks.
- Completed tasks.
- Pending tasks.
- Active habits.
- Weekly productivity score.
Add:
- Today's task list.
- Habit completion overview.
- Upcoming deadlines.
- Weekly productivity chart.
- Quick action buttons.
Use realistic sample data instead of placeholder lorem ipsum.
## 4. Task Management
Build a fully functional task management module.
Users must be able to:
- Create new tasks.
- Edit existing tasks.
- Delete tasks.
- Mark tasks as completed.
- Assign priority (Low, Medium, High).
- Set due dates.
- Assign categories.
- Search tasks.
- Filter by status and priority.
- Sort by deadline or creation date.
Add visual indicators for overdue tasks and completed tasks.
Include an attractive task creation modal.
## 5. Habit Tracker
Create a dedicated habit tracking page.
Features:
- Add new habits.
- Edit and delete habits.
- Mark habits completed for today.
- Display current streaks.
- Show weekly completion history.
- Calculate habit completion percentages.
- Display progress indicators.
Include sample habits such as:
- Read 20 minutes.
- Exercise.
- Drink enough water.
- Practice coding.
- Sleep on time.
## 6. Interactive Calendar
Create a monthly calendar interface.
Features:
- Navigate between months.
- Display scheduled tasks.
- Highlight the current date.
- Click a date to see its tasks.
- Add tasks to selected dates.
- Show task completion status.
Use a clean calendar layout with subtle visual indicators.
## 7. Focus Mode – Pomodoro Timer
Build a working Pomodoro timer.
Features:
- 25-minute focus session.
- 5-minute short break.
- 15-minute long break.
- Start, pause and reset controls.
- Session completion tracking.
- Focus session history.
Allow users to customize focus and break durations.
The timer must actually work using JavaScript.
## 8. Notes Manager
Create a personal notes section.
Features:
- Create notes.
- Edit notes.
- Delete notes.
- Search notes.
- Organize notes using categories.
- Pin important notes.
- Display last modified date.
Save all notes locally.
## 9. Analytics Dashboard
Create an analytics page with interactive charts.
Display:
- Daily task completion.
- Weekly productivity trends.
- Habit consistency.
- Focus hours.
- Task distribution by priority.
- Overall completion rate.
Use Chart.js for charts.
Charts must update when the underlying data changes.
## 10. Settings
Include:
- Light and dark themes.
- User display name customization.
- Pomodoro duration settings.
- Productivity preferences.
- Clear all local application data option with confirmation.
Persist preferences using localStorage.
## 11. JavaScript Functionality
This is a critical requirement.
Every visible interactive element must work.
Implement:
- CRUD operations for tasks, habits and notes.
- LocalStorage persistence.
- Dynamic search.
- Filtering and sorting.
- Working Pomodoro timer.
- Calendar navigation.
- Theme switching.
- Dynamic charts.
- Habit streak calculations.
- Task statistics.
- Toast notifications.
- Confirmation dialogs.
- Empty states and validation messages.
Do not create fake buttons or non-functional UI elements.
Data must persist after refreshing or reopening the browser.
## 12. Animations and User Experience
Use subtle professional animations:
- Smooth page transitions.
- Card hover effects.
- Button feedback.
- Modal fade-in animations.
- Progress bar animations.
- Sidebar transitions.
- Toast notifications.
Respect reduced-motion accessibility preferences.
## 13. Technical Requirements
Use:
- HTML5.
- CSS3.
- Vanilla JavaScript.
- Chart.js for analytics.
- Lucide icons or another lightweight icon library.
Organize the code into reusable functions and separate files.
Suggested project structure:
lifeos/
├── index.html
├── css/
│ └── style.css
├── js/
│ ├── app.js
│ ├── tasks.js
│ ├── habits.js
│ ├── calendar.js
│ ├── timer.js
│ ├── notes.js
│ └── analytics.js
├── assets/
│ └── images/
└── README.md
## 14. Quality Requirements
- Fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile.
- No broken layouts.
- No JavaScript console errors.
- No non-functional buttons.
- Proper input validation.
- Accessible color contrast.
- Semantic HTML.
- Clean and maintainable code.
- Consistent UI components.
- Realistic sample data on first launch.
## Final Objective
Deliver a complete, polished, functional static productivity web application.
The result should look like a real SaaS product that could be showcased in a professional frontend developer portfolio.
Prioritize functionality, design consistency, clean architecture, and user experience over unnecessary visual effects.

sites.title: Suds Squad Immersive
sites.prompt:
Completely transform my existing cleaning company's website into an extremely animation-heavy, visually impressive, premium website. I want an unusually high amount of movement and interactive visual elements. Do not create a basic contractor website with a few fade-in animations. I want the entire website to feel alive, immersive, dynamic, and professionally designed. Think of the visual quality of an award-winning interactive website, combined with the polished presentation of a luxury automotive brand. IMPORTANT: Prioritize animations, moving elements, interactive effects, transitions, and visual storytelling. I want motion throughout practically every section of the website.
## 1. AN EXTREMELY IMPRESSIVE HERO SECTION
Make the opening screen unforgettable.
- Full-screen cinematic background featuring professional exterior house cleaning.
- Animated water spraying across the screen.
- Realistic moving water droplets and splashes.
- Animated sunlight reflections on clean windows.
- Subtle moving particles and atmospheric effects.
- Large typography that animates into position.
- Animated headlines with words appearing individually.
- Moving background layers with parallax depth.
- Floating water droplets that respond to cursor movement.
- Animated CTA buttons with sophisticated hover effects.
- A dramatic transition into the next section as the user scrolls.
The hero should immediately communicate professional, high-quality cleaning services.
## 2. WATER AND CLEANING ANIMATIONS
Create custom animations specifically related to the cleaning industry.
Include:
- Realistic water flowing across surfaces.
- Pressure washer spray animations.
- Water droplets rolling down glass.
- Animated cleaning foam and bubbles.
- Glass becoming visibly cleaner.
- Dirt and grime visually disappearing.
- Animated reflections appearing on cleaned windows.
- Water splashing and flowing off surfaces.
- Subtle sparkle effects after cleaning.
- Animated cleaning equipment and hoses.
These effects should look sophisticated and realistic rather than cartoonish.
## 3. ANIMATED BEFORE-AND-AFTER SHOWCASES
Create large interactive before-and-after demonstrations.
Include:
- House siding before and after pressure washing.
- Dirty and clean driveways.
- Dirty and clean exterior windows.
- Dirty and clean interior windows.
- Clogged and cleaned gutters.
- Dirty and restored patios.
Make these interactive with draggable comparison sliders that reveal the cleaning transformation.
Add smooth transitions, animated labels, moving handles, and subtle visual effects.
## 4. EXTREMELY ANIMATED SERVICES SECTION
Every service should have its own unique animated presentation.
**Pressure Washing**
- Animated pressure washer spray.
- Water particles and splash effects.
- Surface cleaning animations.
**Exterior Window Cleaning**
- Animated squeegee movements.
- Water droplets moving down glass.
- Window reflections becoming clearer.
**Interior Window Cleaning**
- Animated glass cleaning.
- Subtle reflections and sunlight.
- Smooth transitions from cloudy glass to crystal-clear glass.
**Gutter Cleaning**
- Animated leaves moving through gutters.
- Visual gutter cleaning demonstrations.
- Water flowing freely through cleaned gutters.
**House Washing**
- Animated dirt disappearing from siding.
- Water spraying across house exteriors.
- Clean surfaces being revealed.
**Driveway and Patio Cleaning**
- Animated surface restoration.
- Water movement across concrete.
- Before-and-after transformations.
Make service cards interactive, with 3D tilting, moving graphics, hover animations, and smooth transitions.
## 5. MASSIVE SCROLL-BASED ANIMATIONS
I want the website to have an incredible amount of scroll-triggered motion.
Implement:
- Sections that animate into view.
- Images that expand as users scroll.
- Text that reveals itself progressively.
- Backgrounds that change smoothly.
- Elements that move at different scroll speeds.
- Sticky sections with changing content.
- Horizontal scrolling service showcases.
- Animated number counters.
- Moving graphic elements that connect sections.
- Smooth zoom-in and zoom-out effects.
- Layered parallax scrolling.
- Scroll-controlled cleaning demonstrations.
- Sections that transition into each other instead of simply stacking.
Use advanced animation techniques to make scrolling feel like an interactive experience.
## 6. INTERACTIVE BACKGROUNDS
Avoid static backgrounds wherever possible.
Use:
- Slowly moving water textures.
- Animated gradients.
- Floating bubbles.
- Moving light reflections.
- Subtle particles.
- Animated water ripples.
- Flowing lines and shapes.
- Moving background photography.
- Cursor-responsive visual elements.
- Layered depth and perspective effects.
Keep everything coordinated with the cleaning company's branding.
## 7. INTERACTIVE NAVIGATION AND BUTTONS
Make the entire interface feel responsive.
- Animated navigation bar.
- Smooth dropdown menus.
- Animated mobile navigation.
- Buttons with magnetic hover effects.
- Animated arrows.
- Interactive icons.
- Moving underlines.
- Smooth page transitions.
- Cursor-responsive buttons.
- Animated quote and booking buttons.
## 8. ANIMATED PROCESS SECTION
Create an impressive visual explanation of how the cleaning service works.
Show:
1. Customer requests a free estimate.
2. Cleaning service is scheduled.
3. Professional cleaning is performed.
4. Customer receives a beautifully cleaned property.
Animate each stage with its own custom graphics, transitions, and movement.
Connect each step with animated lines or flowing water effects.
## 9. TRUST AND PROFESSIONALISM
Create an attractive section highlighting:
- Professional service.
- Attention to detail.
- Reliable scheduling.
- Quality results.
- Residential cleaning services.
- Interior and exterior window cleaning.
Use animated icons, interactive cards, and subtle motion.

sites.title: Pebble Pop
sites.prompt:
# PEBBLE POP — COMPLETE GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT
Build a complete, production-quality 2D casual puzzle game called **Pebble Pop** using React, Vite, TypeScript and Phaser 3. This must be a fully playable, polished game—not a static UI prototype. Implement every screen, gameplay mechanic, asset, animation, progression system and interaction.
## 1. GAMEPLAY & CORE MECHANICS
Pebble Pop is a relaxing color-matching game where players drop illustrated colorful pebbles into a transparent glass jar.
Core rules:
- 7 columns × 8 rows grid.
- Seven standard pebble varieties.
- Tap a valid column to drop the current pebble.
- Match 3 or more identical orthogonally connected pebbles to clear them.
- Diagonal matches do not count.
- Cleared pebbles award points and create space.
- Automatically detect and resolve cascading matches.
- Each successful drop consumes one move.
- Show the next pebble preview.
- Complete level objectives within the move limit.
- Detect full columns and invalid moves correctly.
- Prevent accidental double inputs during animations.
Use deterministic grid-based logic, not unpredictable physics. The jar should look like a physical glass container, but gameplay must remain reliable and predictable.
Implement a proper game state machine:
READY → DROPPING → MATCHING → CLEARING → CASCADING → READY.
Support LEVEL\_COMPLETE, LEVEL\_FAILED and PAUSED states. Never allow input during incompatible animation states.
## 2. ORIGINAL ARTWORK & ASSET GENERATION
Create a distinctive handcrafted woodland aesthetic. Use warm forest greens, amber, river blues, natural textures, illustrated foliage and beautiful organic details.
Avoid generic mobile-game templates, excessive gradients, emoji substitutes and repetitive AI-style card layouts.
Generate original, reusable assets:
**Pebble sprites:**
- Orange leaf
- Blue swirl
- Purple flower
- Green leaf
- Red blossom
- Yellow sun
- Pink flower
Each variety needs a distinct illustration, color palette and recognizable appearance.
**Special sprites:**
- Frozen pebble
- Stone obstacle
- Flower obstacle
- Crystal
- Golden star
- Lock
- Power-up icons
**Environment assets:**
- Forest, river and waterfall backgrounds.
- Trees, flowers, bushes, rocks and foliage.
- Wooden signs, bridges and lanterns.
- Separate foreground and background layers.
**UI assets:**
- Original logo and app icon.
- Buttons with normal, pressed and disabled states.
- Parchment panels and wooden elements.
- Level nodes, stars, medals and reward icons.
- Counters, progress bars, navigation icons and popups.
**Effects and animations:**
- Falling and bouncing pebbles.
- Match and clearing effects.
- Sparkles, leaves and particle bursts.
- Combo effects and score popups.
- Star celebrations and transitions.
Generate actual image assets and transparent spritesheets where appropriate. Organize assets into reusable, clearly named files. Never use screenshots of the reference UI as game assets.
## 3. COMPLETE SCREEN IMPLEMENTATION
Every screen must be functional and connected to real application state.
**Splash Screen:** Animated logo, floating pebbles and smooth transition.
**Main Menu:** Beautiful woodland illustration, Play, Levels, Daily Challenge, Shop, achievements and settings.
**World Map:** Four illustrated chapters with winding paths, bridges, rivers, decorative objects and level markers.
**Level Selection:** Numbered nodes, completed stars, locked states, current-level highlight and chapter navigation.
**Level Introduction:** Level number, objectives, move limit, pebble illustrations and Start button.
**Gameplay:**
- Level number and pause button.
- Objective counters.
- Remaining moves and score.
- Large central transparent jar.
- Individually rendered interactive pebble grid.
- Current and next pebble previews.
- Three functional power-up controls.
- Beautiful glass reflections, wooden base and rope details.
**Pause:** Resume, restart, settings and exit with confirmation dialogs.
**Level Complete:** Animated stars, final score, earned rewards, best score, Next Level, Replay and Home.
**Level Failed:** Failure explanation, retry and level selection.
**Settings:** Functional music, sound, vibration and language controls. Include How to Play and About.
**Shop:** Simple in-game currency and booster rewards. No real-money purchase infrastructure.
## 4. 40-LEVEL PROGRESSION
Build four chapters containing ten individually configured levels each.
**Chapter 1 — Mossy Grove (1–10)**
- Introduce basic matching.
- Gradually increase target quantities.
- Teach cascades and strategic placement.
**Chapter 2 — Frost Hollow (11–20)**
- Introduce frozen pebbles.
- Adjacent matches unlock frozen pieces.
- Introduce restricted spaces.
**Chapter 3 — Blossom Creek (21–30)**
- Introduce flower obstacles.
- Clear surrounding pebbles to remove obstacles.
- Introduce mixed objectives.
**Chapter 4 — Autumn Ridge (31–40)**
- Introduce stone obstacles.
- More demanding combinations.
- Multiple objectives and tighter move limits.
Every level must have its own data configuration:
- Initial board.
- Available pebble types.
- Objectives and target quantities.
- Move limit.
- Obstacles.
- Difficulty.
- Three-star score thresholds.
- Rewards.
Use reusable level configuration files, not hardcoded individual screens. Make layouts deterministic and testable. Ensure every level is solvable and difficulty increases progressively.
Unlock levels and chapters through actual completion. Display earned stars and saved progress.
## 5. POWER-UPS
Implement three fully functional boosters:
**Hammer:** Remove one selected pebble or permitted obstacle.
**Swap:** Exchange two adjacent pebbles.
**Bomb:** Clear a small surrounding area.
Each needs an original sprite, inventory counter, selection state, animation, cancellation and correct inventory deduction. Award boosters through progression and rewards.
## 6. SCORING & GAME LOGIC
Implement separate, reusable modules for:
- Board generation.
- Pebble placement.
- Match detection.
- Connected-component resolution.
- Clearing and cascading.
- Obstacle handling.
- Objective tracking.
- Move management.
- Scoring and star calculation.
- Booster inventory.
- Level completion and failure.
Ensure counters update accurately, cascades resolve correctly, and impossible board states have a recovery mechanism.
## 7. ANIMATION & AUDIO
Create polished micro-interactions:
- Pebbles fall with subtle bounce.
- Matching pieces pulse before disappearing.
- Cascades receive stronger visual emphasis.
- Counters animate when values change.
- Progress bars update smoothly.
- Stars appear sequentially.
- Buttons have responsive touch states.
- Panels use restrained transitions.
- Foliage has subtle ambient movement.
Add original or properly licensed sounds for dropping, matching, combos, boosters, buttons and level completion. Include optional relaxing background music. Music and sound must have independent settings.
## 8. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
Use React + Vite + TypeScript and Phaser 3.
- Separate React UI from Phaser gameplay.
- Mobile-first portrait design.
- Responsive desktop presentation.
- Reusable components and centralized state.
- Structured level data and asset directories.
- Save progress using localStorage.
- Persist unlocked levels, stars, best scores, currency, boosters and settings.
- Restore progress after reload.
- No backend dependency.
- No sensitive permissions.
- No notification functionality.
- No unnecessary export/import or backup systems.
Use WebP for backgrounds and illustrations where appropriate, PNG for transparent sprites when necessary.
## 9. FINAL QUALITY STANDARD
Test all 40 levels, navigation routes, gameplay states, power-ups and progression.
Verify match detection, cascading, move limits, objectives, scoring, stars, unlocking, restart, persistence and settings.
Ensure:
- No dead buttons.
- No broken navigation.
- No impossible levels.
- No overlapping mobile controls.
- No missing assets.
- No placeholder artwork.
- No unfinished screens.
- No fake functionality.
**Priority:** Deliver a complete, genuinely playable casual game with original handcrafted artwork, beautiful environmental illustrations, satisfying matching mechanics and carefully balanced levels. Every screen must be implemented, every interaction must work, and every visual asset must be intentionally designed. Quality of execution matters more than unnecessary feature count.

sites.title: Preboards Study Hub
sites.prompt:
Build a complete, single-file HTML/CSS/JS web application for a Minimalist Glassmorphism Study & Exam Countdown Hub ("Preboards Hub") with interactive widgets and an integrated AI voice companion.

### 1. Visual Design & UI (Minimal Glassmorphism):
- Theme: Dark/Light mode toggle with smooth transitions. Use a sleek dark slate background (e.g., #0f172a) in dark mode or a clean soft gray in light mode.
- Style: Frosted glass elements (backdrop-filter: blur(16px), semi-transparent white/dark cards, subtle borders, and smooth shadows). Use Tailwind CSS via CDN.
- Typography: Clean modern font ("Plus Jakarta Sans" or "Inter").

### 2. Core Interactive Features:
- Live Countdown Timer: Large, precise countdown tracking down to Days, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds targeting November 27. Include a settings modal to change the target date/time.
- Subject & Status Tracker: A list of exam subjects (e.g., Math, Physics) with status badges ("Not Started", "In Progress", "Revise", "Mastered") that users can cycle through by clicking. Allow adding/deleting subjects.

- Focus Pomodoro Timer: A built-in 25-minute study / 5-minute break timer with Start, Pause, Reset, and Mode toggle controls.
- Daily Motivation: A randomized study quote card with a button to shuffle quotes.

### 3. Interactive AI Voice Companion (Speech Synthesis & Voice UI):
- Add a floating or header "AI Voice Companion" widget featuring an animated sound wave or pulsing orb visualizer.

sites.prompt:
Completely transform my existing cleaning company's website into an extremely animation-heavy, visually impressive, premium website. I want an unusually high amount of movement and interactive visual elements. Do not create a basic contractor website with a few fade-in animations. I want the entire website to feel alive, immersive, dynamic, and professionally designed. Think of the visual quality of an award-winning interactive website, combined with the polished presentation of a luxury automotive brand. IMPORTANT: Prioritize animations, moving elements, interactive effects, transitions, and visual storytelling. I want motion throughout practically every section of the website.
## 1. AN EXTREMELY IMPRESSIVE HERO SECTION
Make the opening screen unforgettable.
- Full-screen cinematic background featuring professional exterior house cleaning.
- Animated water spraying across the screen.
- Realistic moving water droplets and splashes.
- Animated sunlight reflections on clean windows.
- Subtle moving particles and atmospheric effects.
- Large typography that animates into position.
- Animated headlines with words appearing individually.
- Moving background layers with parallax depth.
- Floating water droplets that respond to cursor movement.
- Animated CTA buttons with sophisticated hover effects.
- A dramatic transition into the next section as the user scrolls.
The hero should immediately communicate professional, high-quality cleaning services.
## 2. WATER AND CLEANING ANIMATIONS
Create custom animations specifically related to the cleaning industry.
Include:
- Realistic water flowing across surfaces.
- Pressure washer spray animations.
- Water droplets rolling down glass.
- Animated cleaning foam and bubbles.
- Glass becoming visibly cleaner.
- Dirt and grime visually disappearing.
- Animated reflections appearing on cleaned windows.
- Water splashing and flowing off surfaces.
- Subtle sparkle effects after cleaning.
- Animated cleaning equipment and hoses.
These effects should look sophisticated and realistic rather than cartoonish.
## 3. ANIMATED BEFORE-AND-AFTER SHOWCASES
Create large interactive before-and-after demonstrations.
Include:
- House siding before and after pressure washing.
- Dirty and clean driveways.
- Dirty and clean exterior windows.
- Dirty and clean interior windows.
- Clogged and cleaned gutters.
- Dirty and restored patios.
Make these interactive with draggable comparison sliders that reveal the cleaning transformation.
Add smooth transitions, animated labels, moving handles, and subtle visual effects.
## 4. EXTREMELY ANIMATED SERVICES SECTION
Every service should have its own unique animated presentation.
**Pressure Washing**
- Animated pressure washer spray.
- Water particles and splash effects.
- Surface cleaning animations.
**Exterior Window Cleaning**
- Animated squeegee movements.
- Water droplets moving down glass.
- Window reflections becoming clearer.
**Interior Window Cleaning**
- Animated glass cleaning.
- Subtle reflections and sunlight.
- Smooth transitions from cloudy glass to crystal-clear glass.
**Gutter Cleaning**
- Animated leaves moving through gutters.
- Visual gutter cleaning demonstrations.
- Water flowing freely through cleaned gutters.
**House Washing**
- Animated dirt disappearing from siding.
- Water spraying across house exteriors.
- Clean surfaces being revealed.
**Driveway and Patio Cleaning**
- Animated surface restoration.
- Water movement across concrete.
- Before-and-after transformations.
Make service cards interactive, with 3D tilting, moving graphics, hover animations, and smooth transitions.
## 5. MASSIVE SCROLL-BASED ANIMATIONS
I want the website to have an incredible amount of scroll-triggered motion.
Implement:
- Sections that animate into view.
- Images that expand as users scroll.
- Text that reveals itself progressively.
- Backgrounds that change smoothly.
- Elements that move at different scroll speeds.
- Sticky sections with changing content.
- Horizontal scrolling service showcases.
- Animated number counters.
- Moving graphic elements that connect sections.
- Smooth zoom-in and zoom-out effects.
- Layered parallax scrolling.
- Scroll-controlled cleaning demonstrations.
- Sections that transition into each other instead of simply stacking.
Use advanced animation techniques to make scrolling feel like an interactive experience.
## 6. INTERACTIVE BACKGROUNDS
Avoid static backgrounds wherever possible.
Use:
- Slowly moving water textures.
- Animated gradients.
- Floating bubbles.
- Moving light reflections.
- Subtle particles.
- Animated water ripples.
- Flowing lines and shapes.
- Moving background photography.
- Cursor-responsive visual elements.
- Layered depth and perspective effects.
Keep everything coordinated with the cleaning company's branding.
## 7. INTERACTIVE NAVIGATION AND BUTTONS
Make the entire interface feel responsive.
- Animated navigation bar.
- Smooth dropdown menus.
- Animated mobile navigation.
- Buttons with magnetic hover effects.
- Animated arrows.
- Interactive icons.
- Moving underlines.
- Smooth page transitions.
- Cursor-responsive buttons.
- Animated quote and booking buttons.
## 8. ANIMATED PROCESS SECTION
Create an impressive visual explanation of how the cleaning service works.
Show:
1. Customer requests a free estimate.
2. Cleaning service is scheduled.
3. Professional cleaning is performed.
4. Customer receives a beautifully cleaned property.
Animate each stage with its own custom graphics, transitions, and movement.
Connect each step with animated lines or flowing water effects.
## 9. TRUST AND PROFESSIONALISM
Create an attractive section highlighting:
- Professional service.
- Attention to detail.
- Reliable scheduling.
- Quality results.
- Residential cleaning services.
- Interior and exterior window cleaning.
Use animated icons, interactive cards, and subtle motion.
Do not invent certifications, insurance coverage, testimonials, ratings, or years of experience.
## 10. CONTACT SECTION
Make the quote request section visually impressive.
- Animated background.
- Moving typography.
- Interactive form fields.
- Smooth focus animations.
- Animated buttons.
- Attractive success and error messages.
- Responsive mobile layout.
Preserve all existing contact functionality. All quote requests and contact form submissions must continue going to the company's configured email address.
## 11. ANIMATED FOOTER
Create a dramatic footer with:
- Large animated typography.
- Moving background elements.
- Animated navigation links.
- Subtle water effects.
- Interactive social icons.
- A prominent animated quote button.
## 12. TECHNICAL IMPLEMENTATION
Use advanced web animation techniques.
Consider:
- GSAP.
- GSAP ScrollTrigger.
- Framer Motion.
- CSS keyframe animations.
- SVG animations.
- Canvas-based particle effects.
- WebGL where genuinely beneficial.
- Interactive mouse tracking.
- Smooth scrolling.
- 3D transforms and perspective.
Do not use every technology unnecessarily. Choose the best combination for smooth performance.
Optimize for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Ensure animations do not cause lag, broken layouts, or excessive loading times. Respect reduced-motion accessibility settings.
## 13. FINAL DESIGN DIRECTION
The finished website should feel:
- Extremely dynamic.
- Premium and professional.
- Visually immersive.
- Modern and sophisticated.
- Realistic rather than cartoonish.
- Rich in movement and interactive details.
Use high-quality real-world cleaning photography and realistic visual effects.
Avoid generic contractor templates, static service cards, boring backgrounds, and repetitive fade-in animations.
FINAL REQUIREMENT:
I want substantially more animation than a typical business website. Almost every section should contain multiple moving or interactive elements.
Be ambitious. Add layers of movement, sophisticated transitions, interactive cleaning demonstrations, and visually impressive details.
Do not sacrifice usability for animation. Visitors must still be able to quickly understand the services, request a quote, and contact the business.
Actually implement the complete redesign, not just a visual mockup. Preserve all existing business information and working functionality. Test the entire website on desktop and mobile before finishing.
